title: Proper direct image and relative potential evaluation biduality
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $r\geq1$, and $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$. Let $f:Y\to X$ be a proper morphism between finite-dimensional Noetherian excellent schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-exc-excellent-ring, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Fix a dimension function $\delta_X$ and a pinned potential complex $K_X$ [def-per-potential-dualizing-complex]. Use the ordinary small etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the proper direct image $Rf_*$, and its exceptional right adjoint $f^!$; for a proper map compact support $Rf_!$ is $Rf_*$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Give $K_Y=f^!K_X$ its induced potential pinnings for $\delta_Y(y)=\delta_X(f(y))+\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(f(y))}\kappa(y)$ [lem-per-potential-dualizing-finite-pullback]. Put $D_T=R\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(-,K_T)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], and assume $D_X,D_Y$ preserve $D^b_c$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. For every $M\in D^b_c(Y_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ the pairing
$$Rf_*D_YM\otimes^L Rf_*M\longrightarrow Rf_*(D_YM\otimes^L M)\longrightarrow Rf_*K_Y\longrightarrow K_X$$
(the first arrow is the direct-image tensor map adjoint to the two pullback counits, and the last is the $Rf_*\dashv f^!$ counit) has an invertible internal-Hom transpose
$$a_M:Rf_*D_YM\xrightarrow{\sim}D_XRf_*M.$$
Write $\eta^T_N:N\to D_T^2N$ for the transpose of evaluation after tensor symmetry. The canonical iteration
$$b_M=D_X(a_M^{-1})\circ a_{D_YM}:Rf_*D_Y^2M\xrightarrow{\sim}D_X^2Rf_*M$$
satisfies $b_M\circ Rf_*\eta^Y_M=\eta^X_{Rf_*M}$. No biduality isomorphism is assumed on either scheme.
